# `browser-extension/content.js`

> **Source:** `webgpu-os/browser-extension/content.js`

content.js — runs in the page's MAIN world at document_start. 1. Sets window.__frameUnblockerActive so the OS browser app can detect the extension. 2. In sub-frames (iframes): overrides window.top / window.parent / window.frameElement so frame-busting scripts (e.g. DuckDuckGo: "if (top !== self) top.location = ...") think they are the top-level page and do not navigate away. Must run in world: "MAIN" and all_frames: true to take effect before site JS.
